thread:
Ravi (Support): Escalating Velori trial - activation dropped ~45% after SDK 2.3.1 rollout. Customer sees repeated 503s and session resets. Need CS engagement + enablement ASAP.
Ravi (Support): Repro steps and quick log: `GET /v1/activate 503 {"error":"kv-cache-miss","code":503}`. Customer PST.
Maya (CS): Looping in @Ethan. Thanks Ravi — can you confirm exact customer timezone and preferred windows?
Ravi (Support): PST (Pacific). They said pilot launch next week. Steps to repro: 1) init SDK 2) batch embed 3) ~30s later 503. Customer quote: "we can't reliably onboard test users".
Ethan (CS Manager): Marking P1 for trial retention. Proposed plan: (A) 1h triage with Eng runtime oncall, (B) 45m enablement session with customer engineers, (C) daily check-ins for 3 days, capture action items. Who will own external comms?
Priya (Solutions Eng): I can lead the deep-dive and the 45m enablement. Available Friday 11:00am PST. I'll prep a troubleshooting doc + runbook snippet.
Maya (CS): I'll own comms and send the calendar invite to Velori + Ravi. Suggested invite title: "Velori onboarding triage & enablement — Redwood".
Ravi (Support): Context: Customer on Dedicated trial (2 reserved GPUs). Spike observed after cache warming flag got disabled in the SDK change. Suspect batching param regression or cache priming issue.
ops-bot: Incident created INC-2026-2247, paging eng-runtime oncall.
Ethan (CS Manager): Comms plan (high level): email with agenda, scope, owners, expected outcomes, rollback option (SDK 2.2.x), and post-session action items. I'll draft and drop here in 30m.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Runbook excerpt we'll use during triage: ```1) verify prefix cache enabled; 2) set batch_size=8; 3) monitor tokens/sec (~1500 expected); 4) check KV cache hit ratio; 5) temp rollback to 2.2.x if degradation persists```
Maya (CS): Owners: Customer comms — Maya; Oncall liaison — Ravi; Enablement lead — Priya; Escalation owner — Ethan. I'll notify legal if any escalated contract/SLA language is needed.
Ravi (Support): Velori asked for a bridge today if possible. Their comment: "we risk missing pilot launch". Can we try for 10:30am PST or earliest availability?
Maya (CS): Sending invite for 10:30am PST (11:00 fallback). Will cc engineering and record session. CCR: record session, capture enablement deck, and action items in the postmortem.
Ethan (CS Manager): Please also capture ROI metric and renewal signal in Gainsight. Add metric: activation_pct_delta and log baseline/after.
Maya (CS): Will log renewal_risk: high and next_touch: 2026-03-22T10:30:00-08:00 in Gainsight.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Prep notes: include guidance for batch tuning, cache priming script, and a short checked list to avoid rolling changes during high-activation windows. I'll attach docs to the invite.
Ravi (Support): Thanks team. I'll push a short customer-facing summary after the triage and keep the thread updated with eng findings.
Maya (CS): Perfect — keep updates here. After the enablement we'll run a follow-up capture: onboarding funnel delta, SDK version in use, and any custom client logic.
Ethan (CS Manager): If we see repeated regressions, we'll propose a temporary pin for Velori and offer an extended sandbox window to recover confidence.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: INC-2026-2247 follow-up in 24h.
Maya (CS): Closing the loop for now — invite sent. Ravi, Priya, Ethan, please add any missing blockers ASAP.
